title: SG-2.2 Author the boy sheet and portrait
summary: Boy 32x48 sheet (idle 4, walk 6, interact 4) and 32x32 portrait generated as palette-only PNGs and declared in the manifest
description: Context: game/frontend/src/art has draw helpers, room sources and a generator (scripts/generateArt.ts, src/lib/generateAssets.ts) but no boy art source, and ArtSource has no animations or origin. Desired behavior: boy sources exist, are registered in ART_SOURCES, and art:generate writes boy PNGs plus manifest entries with animation frame ranges and rates. Expected result: manifest declares the PNG sheet at 448x48 and the portrait at 32x32. Why: replaces placeholder art; switching scene content to these assets belongs to SG-2.3.
acceptance_criteria: Given the boy sheet source, when its frames are counted, then there are 14 frames of 32x48 using only palette indices
Given the boy portrait source, when its grid is read, then it is 32x32 and uses only palette indices
Given the generator, when it runs on the boy sources, then manifest entries carry animations idle 0-3, walk 4-9, interact 10-13 with frame rates, plus origin
Given the manifest, when read, then boy sheet and portrait entries exist as PNG paths at their declared sizes and scene content is not changed

out_of_scope: switching world content or scene to the new assets
preserve: existing room sources and hand cursor source
existing SVG manifest entries and character:boy id

technical_constraints: Phaser stays on 3.90.x; React, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind, Radix, Zustand stay
All art is raster pixel art generated from source data by a deterministic script; no downloaded art
One shared palette of at most 48 colours (src/lib/palette.ts)
Tests are unit tests with all dependencies mocked
Scene content stays data-driven; no hardcoded ids in scene classes
definition_of_done: All requirements met and their Verify units pass
non_functional: Generation is deterministic: identical bytes on each run
